scope: Code review probes only; no live services, messages, database or network were used.

probes.observed: Database configuration remains present after shadow setup.
With database configuration available, audit.record reaches schema-writing code; ShadowStore does not guard it.
get_store selects LocalStore when the write token is missing, even with WORKER_MODE=live.
--once exits 0 when the only resort result is error.
An HTTP 200 empty response is accepted without calling the public fallback.
With SEND_ENABLED=0, digest attempts a send; after the simulated timeout, the next invocation skips the permanently claimed recipient.
